title: School and Community Watch
learning_focus: School, community, and outdoor hazards; reporting and prevention.
story_premise: A route from school to the park contains damaged steps, litter, poor lighting, stray hazards, and unsafe crowding.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: School, community, and outdoor hazards; reporting and prevention.

areas.title: Classroom Zone
areas.story: Arrange bags, furniture, and walkways safely. Inspect surfaces and equipment before use.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: A health or safety concern is affecting Classroom Zone.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Arrange bags, furniture, and walkways safely.

opening_dialogue.speaker: Health Guide
opening_dialogue.text: Observe the signs, think about School, community, and outdoor hazards, then apply the safest healthy action.

learning_clues: Health focus: School, community, and outdoor hazards.
Observe signs, context, and available trusted support before acting.
